includes.comment: ServiceLoader discovery files for all backend/frontend/server SPI implementations

JVM runtime source fragments — compile-jvm inlines these into the emitted Scala. Missing here, `ssc compile-jvm` FAILED in the native binary with 'JVM runtime resource not found on classpath: /scalascript/jvm-runtime/stubServeRuntime' while working on the JVM launcher. Nothing tested compile-jvm on the native lane, so it shipped broken in v0.1.0.
GraalVM native-image marker (avoids reflection fallback warnings)

Every generated *-sources root in one pattern, deliberately. These hold Scala source fragments that compile-jvm inlines into the script it emits, they are produced by resourceGenerators so they never appear under src/main/resources, and each missing one surfaces only as the NEXT failure of the same command: jvm-runtime, then http-server-spi-sources, then http-server-common-sources, one per 2.5-minute image build. build.sbt currently generates four (logger, http-server-{common,jvm,spi}); the wildcard covers the fifth nobody has written yet.
